name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (gfx/blit). 'animated' captures the 0x08 anim-flip handling, 'tile' is correct (paints one battle-map tile sprite), 'at_pos' reflects the world (x,y) args. No address residue. Accurately reflects purpose and internal logic.
purpose: Paint a single battle-map tile sprite at world tile coords (tile_x, tile_y) into a render workspace buffer, applying animation-flip sprite selection and an optional per-chapter palette remap; silently no-ops if the tile is outside the visible battle window.
logic_summary: Window bounds check with +-1 tile margin (origin_x-1<=tile_x<=origin_x+max_x, origin_y-1<=tile_y<=origin_y+max_y+1, tile_y>=0); else return. Resolve per-cell tile metadata at battle_tile_map_ptr + (tile_y*map_width_tiles + tile_x)*4. tile_id = *(u16)(meta+4) & 0x3FF (low 10 bits). Look up tile attribute flags at attribute_flags_buffer_ptr + tile_id*4. If flag 0x08 (animated): tile_id += bg_anim_flip_flag*2. If flag 0x80 (renderable): resolve sprite_src from battle_scene_snapshot offset table (snapshot + *(int)(snapshot+10+tile_id*4)); compute dst = buf + 0x8088 + (tile_y-origin_y)*0x2AC0 + (tile_x-origin_x)*0x18. If meta+7 == 0xFF (no cursor overlay) -> plain passthrough blit (pitch 0x1C8); else -> remap blit, with remap_table = tile_anim_table_base + *(int)(tile_anim_table_base + 6 + tile_anim_palette_phase_lookup[tile_map_anim_frame_counter]*4). Tiles without flag 0x80 (transparent) skip the blit entirely.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_blit_animated_tile_at_pos(uint32 buf, int32 tile_x, int32 tile_y)

params.name: buf
params.semantics: Base linear address of the battle render-workspace buffer; destination pixels are written at buf + 0x8088 + row/col offsets. Caller passes data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr.
params.reason: Optional consistency rename: 'buf' is generic and does not distinguish source from destination. Sibling blitters in this file use dst/dst_buf, the source comment block and the Ghidra plate already refer to it as 'dst_buf', and it is unambiguously the destination buffer. Not address-tainted; recorded for Stage 2 only.

params.name: tile_x
params.semantics: World tile-grid X coordinate of the cell to paint (column index into battle_tile_map). Caller passes the moving char's tile X (+-1 for the walk-trail neighbours).
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate; matches usage as a tile-grid column index. No address residue.

params.name: tile_y
params.semantics: World tile-grid Y coordinate of the cell to paint (row index into battle_tile_map). Caller passes the moving char's tile Y (and y-1/y-2 for the 1x2 sprite footprint and walk-trail).
params.reason: Descriptive and accurate; matches usage as a tile-grid row index. No address residue.

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is the blit into buf (or a silent no-op when out-of-window or the tile is transparent / not renderable).

comment_original_issue: Source comment block (lines 60-83) is accurate, concise, ASCII, and matches the decompilation (window bounds with +-1 margin, per-cell tile metadata layout, attribute-flag bits 0x08/0x80, destination layout/stride). No correction needed. Minor: it refers to the destination as 'dst_buf' while the param is currently named 'buf'; this reconciles once the proposed Stage-2 param rename lands and reads as descriptive prose meanwhile, so left unchanged.
